import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime
import os
import warnings
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")


def haversine_distance_vectorized(lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2):
    """Calculate distance between two points in km (vectorized)"""
    R = 6371  # Earth radius in km
    lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2 = (
        np.radians(lon1),
        np.radians(lat1),
        np.radians(lon2),
        np.radians(lat2),
    )
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))
    return R * c


def extract_time_features(df, datetime_col):
    """Extract time-based features from datetime column"""
    df[datetime_col] = pd.to_datetime(df[datetime_col], errors="coerce")
    df["pickup_hour"] = df[datetime_col].dt.hour
    df["pickup_day"] = df[datetime_col].dt.day
    df["pickup_month"] = df[datetime_col].dt.month
    df["pickup_year"] = df[datetime_col].dt.year
    df["pickup_weekday"] = df[datetime_col].dt.dayofweek
    return df


def compute_distances(df):
    """Compute distances vectorized"""
    return haversine_distance_vectorized(
        df["pickup_longitude"].values,
        df["pickup_latitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_longitude"].values,
        df["dropoff_latitude"].values,
    )


def filter_nyc_coords(df):
    """Filter rows with valid NYC coordinates"""
    mask = (
        (df["pickup_latitude"].notna())
        & (df["pickup_longitude"].notna())
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"].notna())
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"].notna())
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] > 40.5)
        & (df["pickup_latitude"] < 41.5)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] > -74.2)
        & (df["pickup_longitude"] < -73.7)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] > 40.5)
        & (df["dropoff_latitude"] < 41.5)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] > -74.2)
        & (df["dropoff_longitude"] < -73.7)
    )
    return df[mask]


print("Loading data...")
labels = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {labels.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test.shape}")

# Filter training data to keep only NYC coordinates
print("\nFiltering training data for valid NYC coordinates...")
labels = filter_nyc_coords(labels)
print(f"Valid training rows after filtering: {len(labels)}")

# Downsample for tractable training (keep ~200K samples)
print("\nDownsampling training data...")
if len(labels) > 200000:
    labels = labels.sample(n=200000, random_state=42).reset_index(drop=True)
print(f"Downsampled training rows: {len(labels)}")

# Preprocessing
print("\nPreprocessing features...")
data = labels.copy()
test_data = test.copy()

# Extract time features
data = extract_time_features(data, "pickup_datetime")
test_data = extract_time_features(test_data, "pickup_datetime")

# Drop rows with NaN datetime
data.dropna(subset=["pickup_datetime"], inplace=True)
test_data.dropna(subset=["pickup_datetime"], inplace=True)

# Distance features (vectorized)
print("Computing distances...")
data["distance"] = compute_distances(data)
test_data["distance"] = compute_distances(test_data)

# Clip extreme values for distance
data["distance"] = data["distance"].clip(0.1, 50.0)
test_data["distance"] = test_data["distance"].clip(0.1, 50.0)

# Prepare feature columns
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_longitude",
    "pickup_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "pickup_hour",
    "pickup_day",
    "pickup_month",
    "pickup_weekday",
    "distance",
]

target_col = "fare_amount"

print(f"Data shape after preprocessing: {data.shape}")

# Split data into train and validation (80/20 split)
train_data, val_data = train_test_split(
    data, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True
)

print(f"Train set size: {len(train_data)}")
print(f"Validation set size: {len(val_data)}")

# Prepare training data
X_train = train_data[feature_cols]
y_train = train_data[target_col]
X_val = val_data[feature_cols]
y_val = val_data[target_col]

# Prepare test data
X_test = test_data[feature_cols]

# Train LightGBM model with reduced parameters
print("\nTraining LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.LGBMRegressor(
    n_estimators=100,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    max_depth=6,
    num_leaves=15,
    min_child_samples=5,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=4,
    verbose=-1,
)

model.fit(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(20, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set using RMSE
print("\nEvaluating on validation set...")
val_predictions = model.predict(X_val)
val_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_predictions))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")

# Predict on test set
print("\nGenerating predictions for test set...")
test_predictions = model.predict(X_test)

# Clip predictions to reasonable range
test_predictions = test_predictions.clip(2.0, 300.0)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"key": test_data["key"], "fare_amount": test_predictions})

# Save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")

# Print final validation metrics
print(f"\nFinal Validation RMSE: {val_rmse:.4f}")
